info.title: Cliniko Universal API
info.description: Manage patients, appointments, invoices, and treatment notes

get.description: Retrieves an appointment type from your Cliniko account.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Cliniko appointment type ID.

parameters.name: fields
